versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Rats pass Gossip to touching neighbours; at 3 Gossip a unit Blurts, uses its text and spreads the news down the line.
Build the board as a fuse: spend chains while recruiting for stats, or hold units at two pips and set the whole board off in the fight.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Wrote down the Gossip leftover rule, when Ilse and Gundel check for 2 Gossip, what the Landlady's gold cap counts, and stopped the Thirty-Two copying itself forever.
Added early spark: the Taster and Huddler bring a pip of their own, and Strays come with 2 Gossip so they re-light the wire.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Closed the last rules gaps: the Thirty-Two's copied texts keep their limits (the Landlady's cap moved into her Blurt), and Fips has a tie rule.
Lifted the quiet cards: the Taster's Blurt also buffs a neighbour, the Tangle's Strays land touching it twice per chain, and Ilse reads in one line.
